verdict.rationale: Airbyte OSS can be self-hosted anywhere via Docker/Kubernetes (docs-12,13,28,45), which indirectly lets a user control where data is processed/stored, but there is no explicit documentation of Airbyte Cloud region selection or formal data-residency guarantees for AI-native workflows. missing for 10: explicit region/residency controls for Airbyte Cloud, compliance certifications tied to region choice, and any AI-specific residency guidance.
